Nadia, Gideon ended up at **280 seats** for Vantorre Group in his July 1 update in #strategic-pod.

He first posted 300. A few minutes later he corrected it to 280, because the 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The 280 is the active seat count on the production roster as of July 1. Ruth acknowledged the corrected number in the thread.

Use 280 for the pod roster sheet.
